`final class NodeBindings`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.binding` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeBindings.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/binding/NodeBindings.java)

Signal bindings, followed suppliers, watches and queued events of one node or one UI.

## Description

Each [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/) and each [`UI`](/reference/ui/ui/) owns one.
It subscribes to its signals when the node is attached and unsubscribes when it is detached, reads its followed suppliers before each frame, and delivers the events of its [`InteractiveValue`](/reference/signals/interactivevalue/)s in the order of the changes, once the signals have settled.
A custom node reaches it through `getBindings()` to create its own interactive values.

<a id="NodeBindings-constructor"></a>

### NodeBindings

`NodeBindings(Object owner, EventBus eventBus, Supplier<String> name, Consumer<Runnable> runner)` 

Creates the bindings of `owner`, which fires its events on `eventBus`, is named by `name` in the warnings and runs each event listener through `runner`.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-close"></a>

<a id="NodeBindings-method-release"></a>

### release

`void release(String property)`

<a id="NodeBindings-method-releaseFollows"></a>

### releaseFollows

`void releaseFollows()` 

Drops every followed supplier and keeps the bindings to signals, as on the copy of a node.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-subscribe"></a>

### subscribe

`void subscribe(boolean loaded)` 

Listens to the bound and watched signals, at the attachment of the node.
A bound property takes the value its signal reached while the node was detached; when `loaded` is `true`, a watch whose signal changed meanwhile runs once.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-unsubscribe"></a>

### unsubscribe

`void unsubscribe()` 

Stops listening to the signals, at the detachment of the node.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-follow"></a>

### follow

`<T, V> T follow(String property, Supplier<V> supplier, Consumer<V> applier)` 

Applies the value of `supplier` to `property` now and again before each frame when it changes, then returns the owner.
A constant [`ComputedSignal`](/reference/signals/computedsignal/) applies once and is not kept.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-bind"></a>

### bind

`this bind(String property, Signal<V> signal, Consumer<V> applier, Function<M,V> writer)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Binds `property` to `signal` in both directions, then returns the owner: `applier` receives each value of the signal except `null`, and `writer` turns the value of the node into the value to write back.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` when the signal is read-only.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-bindNullable"></a>

### bindNullable

`<T, V, M> T bindNullable(String property, Signal<V> signal, Consumer<V> applier, Function<M,V> writer)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The … of … is changed by the user, so it cannot follow …, which cannot be written: pass a writable Signal, or its value as a start value

Binds `property` like `bind(...)`, and passes `null` values to `applier` too.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-sync"></a>

### sync

`void sync(String property, Object value)` 

Writes `value` back to the signal bound to `property`.
When bound controls keep correcting each other's value, it stops after 16 corrections, restores the value of the signal and prints a dev warning.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-batch"></a>

### batch

`void batch(Runnable runnable)` 

Runs `runnable` inside a batch.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-watch"></a>

### watch

`<T> T watch(Signal<?> signal, BooleanSupplier condition, Runnable action)` 

Runs `action` after each change of `signal` while `condition` is `true` and the node is attached, then returns the owner.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-pull"></a>

### pull

`void pull()` 

Reads every followed supplier and applies the values that changed.
When an applier throws, JOID prints a warning and the property keeps its previous value.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-listen"></a>

### listen

`<T> T listen(EventType<?> type, EventListener<?> listener)`

<a id="NodeBindings-method-fire"></a>

### fire

`this fire(EventType<?> type, Supplier<E> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Creates the event with `event` and fires it, and returns it; it returns `null` and creates nothing when no listener waits for this type.
A cancellable or consumable event fires at once; another one waits for the end of the batch in progress.

<a id="NodeBindings-method-fireSubscribed"></a>

### fireSubscribed

`<E extends Event> E fireSubscribed(EventType<?> type, Supplier<E> event)` 

Fires like `fire(...)` while the node is attached, after the signal notifications in progress; it returns `null` when the node is detached.

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
